segments.text: And the audience resonance is off the charts. YouTube comment analysis shows overwhelming demand for full episodic treatment, physical artbooks, and vinyl soundtracks, with an average backer spend of over sixty euros.

segments.text: There are operational questions to evaluate. The unit cost for hand-drawn 2D action animation sits around twenty thousand euros per minute. Without an established coproduction studio attached, scaling beyond short form presents cash-flow risk.
